scenes.headline: How Needle 3 scores its own tool calls
scenes.sub: The confidence head, and why a local fine-tune drops it.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Radar! Needle 3, a tiny tool-calling model, scores its own calls. Here's how, and why local fine-tuning loses it.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: A small post-hoc head reads the whole network, prompt and finished call together, and judges the call after it is made.
scenes.say: A small post-hoc head reads the whole network, prompt and finished call together, and judges the call afterwards.

steps.say: The head reads the prompt and call at all twenty-one depths: the embedding, plus each of the twenty blocks.
Eighty-four probe vectors, one per depth and lane, each pool the trace into a summary.
Four query vectors attend across those summaries, then project down to one logit.
Confidence is the lower of that score and the decoder's own probability. Both have to agree.

scenes.title: Why a local fine-tune drops it

items.say: The head reads the backbone under stop gradient. Training it cannot move one weight of the model it judges.
It was trained in a separate run and merged in afterwards. No gradient path reaches it.
A local LoRA moves accuracy eighteen to thirty-six points, so the old head would predict failures that no longer happen.
So the build deletes the head, and confidence comes back as None.

scenes.title: How far a fine-tune moves the model
scenes.credit: Cactus's own fine-tuning chart, panel 2 of 2

steps.say: Cactus's own chart, on Mobile Actions: grey is the base, orange the fine-tune.
The two-layer slice goes from zero point nine to sixty-six point seven.
At twenty layers, the tuned bar sits below the base.

scenes.title: A 20-layer archive, by export path
scenes.note: computed from the shipped file's own tensor records
scenes.say: The local path also exports at four bits: its packer refuses anything else. A tuned archive is sixty-three point four four megabytes, not thirty-five point three four.

scenes.text: Calibration is a fit, and a fit needs samples: the head has to be retrained with the model, on your tools.
scenes.say: Calibration is a fit, and a fit needs samples. The head must be retrained with the model, on your tools.

recap: A detached probe judges each finished call
A local LoRA can't train it, so build drops it
Local archives export at 4 bits, not 2
scenes.say: A detached probe judges each call; a local fine-tune drops it and exports at four bits.
